question: does the d4g die SM (ot_hbm_accel_smh_attn) have a usable INT8 path for Qwen fmt-3 SM.MATVEC?
answer: YES: the opt-in fixed-calendar adapter ot_smh_static_int8 (real ot_hbm_accel_int8_line converter, 1ce966147) existed but was not instantiated in the die master; now wired behind ot_hbm_accel_smh_attn #(.ENABLE_INT8) (default 0 = unchanged). command[116] marks a packed 128-code line; the two widened BF16 lines reach the static front 2 and 3 cycles later and issue as ordinary fmt-0 lines.
exactness: INT8 codes exact in BF16; BF16xBF16 products exact in FP32; the SM's fmt-0 chunk8 csum == hgi_sim.lib.sm_int8 (fmt-3 golden, raw FP32 sums). Row scale applied after the reduction by the SU consumer (qwen_compiler row_scale_qkv/o/gu/down, head_scale), not the SM. Captured O reproduced by lib.sm_int8 and by V.csum on the widened image for every record; the compiler checks every packed line (first 256/op) widened by a converter model == the fmt-0 lines.
fixture: Qwen3-8B D4G8 L0 (qwen_d4g_proof.run_stage, position 8191, proof PASS), rank-0 die, captured by qwen_sm_mv_kv.py: kv/sm_mv.json (npz on ot-epyc5:/srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/smb-int8/kv/L0, sha in json)
bench: Verilator 5.050, ot-epyc5, GEN2b bundle swx2b master files + this tree's ot_hbm_accel_smh_attn (ENABLE_INT8 1) + ot_smh_static_int8 + ot_hbm_accel_int8_line; tb_hbm_smh_attn -DOT_SMH_ATTN_INT8

positive_sm0_busiest_SM.note: standalone op incl. ~134-cycle drain; every op within price (lines + 346.6 overhead); the INT8 issue rate (64 codes/cycle/SM, one packed line per two edges) is exactly the rate the d4g Qwen price charges

avoided_cost_bf16_widened_image.model: fmt-0 BF16 image = 2x HBM bytes; the SM would be HBM-bound at 99 B/cycle/SM instead of issue-bound at 64 B/cycle (128 B BF16 line per cycle > 99): SM.MATVEC line part x 128/99 = 1.293 (overhead 346.6/op unchanged), from results/rtl/hbm_qwen_layer_tput_1018/static_schedule.json d4g8

area_estimate_int8_adapter: per SM: ~2.7k flops (converter a_data 1088 + m_data 1088 + high-half codes 512 + tags/valids ~34) + 64 x (8-bit magnitude/priority-encode/shift) lanes + 1099-bit 2:1 packet mux; x16 SM / die. No closed physical view of ot_smh_static_int8 exists (estimate only).
default_off_regression: PASS: sm_mv_unit DS L00 k4 sm0 smoke with this tree's ot_hbm_accel_smh_attn at default params (unit/regress_default.json)
coverage_all_rows: PASS: every row of the rank-0 die bit-exact (qkv 768, o 4096, gu 3072, down 2048 = 9,984 rows; unit/L0_all.json)
